verdict.rationale: AgentMail is documented as a hosted email API, so self-hosting is a fair question for this product. The only evidence pointing toward it is a single community comment saying the enterprise options include "Bring Your Own Cloud." Custom domains and IMAP/SMTP access are adjacent features and do not count as self-hosting. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a self-hosted or BYOC deployment, availability outside the enterprise tier, details of how the mail pipeline (sending/receiving infrastructure) runs under the customer's control, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control

citations.quote: They appreciated that the enterprise options include Bring Your Own Cloud, which 'makes things much easier for us.'
